worldcombat.skill.poisontail.summary: Turn low and sweep the tail through a half-circle along the ground: everyone in the low arc is hit, the one in front takes full power, the rest a discount, and the venomous tip may poison each of them (more likely farther out) while shoving them slightly away. Venom form is more toxic but sweeps lighter; Sweep form is wider and heavier but poisons less.
worldcombat.skill.poisontail.description: The foe in front takes about %1$s Poison contact damage; the sweep reaches %2$s blocks over a %3$s degree arc, hitting every enemy inside once.
Other enemies caught by the arc take %1$s times that damage and are shoved about %2$s blocks away.

Each hit has a %1$s base chance to poison its target for %2$s, likelier the farther out along the arc. The poison wears off on its own, dealing damage over time but unable to finish the target off; Poison and Steel types are immune.
worldcombat.skill.poisontail.venom.on: Venom form: poison chance x1.25, poison duration x1.15; costs sweep power x0.9 and a narrower arc.
worldcombat.skill.poisontail.venom.off: Sweep form: a wider, heavier sweep; costs a harder time smearing poison.
worldcombat.skill.poisontail.timing: Range %1$s, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.poisontail.growth.0: From level %1$s the sweep power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.poisontail.growth.1: From level %1$s the sweep power is %2$s and the poison chance rises to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.poisontail.use.0: A low half-circle sweep that catches a crowd
worldcombat.skill.poisontail.use.1: Smear poison on several close targets
worldcombat.skill.poisontail.use.2: Shove a close press off the body a little
On: poison chance x1.25, poison duration x1.15, but sweep power x0.9 and a narrower arc - for smearing poison. Off (Sweep form): a wider, heavier sweep, but poison is harder to land.
Beyond this distance it closes in first; the sweep reach is short, so a large value often still cannot reach.
Prioritize Poison Tail when this many foes are in its sweep. A smaller crowd lowers its priority but keeps the attack available.
When on, a target not already poisoned ranks higher so the tip's venom lands on someone new; when off all targets rank alike.
